H.claim_limit: No force or grasp-force claim; receiver grasp is evidenced by ordered gripper telemetry plus independent receiver-only board retention, not by video force inference.
fail_events: gripper front edge is visibly outside a required physical insertion band
controller/gripper failure or residual-adjusted pair failure
H.pass_boundary: All required events, ordering, durations, board-pose envelope, controller/gripper dispositions, trace coverage and residual-adjusted non-intentional pair bounds pass.
required_scored_events: sender grasp established before receiver close
the original video shows a continuous dual-grasp interval spanning at least 45 frame transitions, while the controller/gripper trace independently shows the frozen dual-grasp hold
after sender release the original video shows receiver-only retention spanning at least 75 frame transitions, while the controller/gripper trace independently shows the frozen receiver-only hold
qualified carry/retreat completes without visible drop
sender front edge is visibly inside the frozen 34-to-36-mm physical band before close, and receiver front edge is visibly inside the frozen 58-to-62-mm physical band before authority transfer
required_visible_entities: complete paperboard, its 119-mm centreline and its prospectively frozen insertion-depth marks
unknown_events: required entity or event is occluded
required marks, gripper edge or retention interval are occluded
the original video frame sequence or duration metadata is discontinuous or unreadable
board attachment cannot be bounded by the required physical bands
trace or pair coverage is incomplete without an independently observed failure

R.claim_limit: Operator placement alone is not an independent BASE_SEATED PASS. The fixed phone independently records visible containment, support, ownership order and stationary dwell, but does not produce a metric 6-DoF pose.
fail_events: wrong ownership order or simultaneous occupancy
foam outside the frozen placement/support envelope
foam crosses the physical polygon, visibly tilts, slips or loses support
controller failure or residual-adjusted pair failure
R.pass_boundary: The fixed owner sequence, BASE_SEATED observer bounds, no-simultaneous-occupancy rule, controller traces and residual-adjusted non-intentional pair bounds all pass.
required_scored_events: clear interval with no arm occupying the resource zone
foam bottom remains on the qualified support plane and inside the frozen placement polygon

foam remains visibly inside the frozen physical polygon, bottom face visibly supported, and visibly stationary for at least 30 consecutive frame transitions; the controller trace independently shows the frozen resource dwell
right-only occupancy begins only after qualified BASE_SEATED
required_visible_entities: frozen physical placement polygon and the visible support edge
unknown_events: support contact, polygon or required foam edge is occluded
the original video frame sequence or duration metadata is discontinuous or unreadable
BASE_SEATED containment/stationary duration cannot be bounded
trace or pair coverage is incomplete without an independently observed failure

analyzer.qualification: Synthetic metric-camera qualification is retained as tool evidence only. Real intrinsic attempts failed; this analyzer is not part of the final metric error budget.

camera_metric_calibration_disposition.decision: Metric camera calibration is closed NOT_QUALIFIED. No further checkerboard capture, camera-calibration tool work or pixel-to-millimetre claim is allowed for this campaign.

categorical_boundary_rule.PASS_visibility_condition: The required edge/object is clearly visible and strictly inside the applicable physical boundary throughout the scored observation interval.
categorical_boundary_rule.UNKNOWN_condition: Any required edge touches a boundary line, is blurred across it, is occluded, or cannot be visually separated from it.

common_identity.camera: one fixed Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max, rear main camera, original 1080x1920 at 30 fps, unchanged lens/zoom/focus/exposure and mounting within a family block
common_identity.payload_resource_marker: optional identity marker only; its mass remains part of object identity if attached, but no marker-derived metric pose enters a scored gate
common_identity.raw_media: original, unedited and uncompressed video retained for every H/R slot
common_identity.scored_combination: Observer evidence, controller/gripper traces and actual-state FCL must each pass their own frozen rule; no millisecond-level cross-device fusion is claimed, and video alone never certifies hidden-surface collision or force
common_identity.support_marker: optional identity marker only; no ArUco-derived metric pose enters a scored gate
common_identity.time_alignment: No metric phone-to-host alignment is used. Original video adjudicates visible order, retention, occupancy and within-video duration; controller/gripper/joint traces are adjudicated on their own host timeline. A visible slot identity/start slate binds media identity but does not claim sub-frame synchronization.

evidence_protocol_boundary: The evidence protocol does not treat a camera as required metric instrumentation. After three retained checkerboard analyses failed the pre-frozen metric intrinsic gate, this campaign uses one fixed external phone only as an independent categorical H/R event, retention and occupancy observer. Metric placement bounds come from prospectively frozen physical marks or boxes plus robot/controller telemetry, not pixel-to-millimetre conversion.
freeze_rule: No checkerboard, pixel-to-mm, card-pair retuning or new camera protocol is permitted. Occlusion or boundary ambiguity is UNKNOWN and is not replaced.

h_camera_view_entry.final_condition: both arms stationary at the retained H sender/receiver view pose and both grippers open
h_camera_view_entry.remaining: Completed by h_static_view_qualification; no additional robot motion was needed for the image.

h_static_view_qualification.accepted_fact: One original 5712 x 4284 JPEG simultaneously shows both open grippers and the complete horizontal transfer region, without personal or school identifiers.
h_static_view_qualification.paperboard_disposition: No board is present in the still. The six insertion marks therefore remain a per-slot staged-frame and continuous-video visibility gate; occlusion or blur is UNKNOWN.
h_static_view_qualification.remaining: Keep this direction fixed for the original continuous H video and hash-bind it to the slot.

open_inputs: runtime-only: before each H/R slot, the fixed view and visible slot slate must pass
runtime-only: after each H/R slot, retain and hash the original continuous video

physical_marking_receipt.effect: physical addition is no longer an open preparation action; H/R static view geometry is qualified and only final continuous-media identity rules remain
physical_marking_receipt.h_marks: left 34/35/36 mm and right 58/60/62 mm receiver-edge bands operator-reported complete
physical_marking_receipt.r_polygon: centered nominal 85 x 85 mm inner square operator-reported complete

physical_metric_inputs.boundary: Retained measurements are design inputs. The operator reports that the six H receiver-edge lines and centered nominal 85 x 85 mm R inner square are physically complete. Video remains categorical: visibly inside is classifiable; boundary contact, blur or occlusion is UNKNOWN. No pixel-to-millimetre uncertainty is inferred.
physical_metric_inputs.foam: 75 x 75 x 45 mm, 10.0 g; existing outer placement box approximately 89 x 89 mm; ruler resolution reported as 1 mm for these retained measurements
physical_metric_inputs.paperboard: 237 x 170 x 1 mm, 20.0 g; left insertion observations 36,36,36,34,36 mm; receiver front-edge observation 60 mm; ruler resolution reported as 1 mm for these retained measurements
physical_metric_inputs.right_gripper_closed_home: Validated live-feedback identity band [-0.0005, 0.0001] m; the underlying calibration record is omitted from this compact projection.

privacy_and_publication_boundary.accidental_identity_rule: If a pre-campaign calibration recording captures identifying information, repeat the no-motion recording before campaign freeze instead of editing the file and calling it original.
privacy_and_publication_boundary.capture_rule: Exclude faces, names, school names/logos, badges, student IDs, room signs, readable screens, email/terminal content and identifying reflections before recording. A hand may briefly operate the black/white sync card without showing identifying clothing or features.
privacy_and_publication_boundary.publication_rule: Any published frame/video is a separately derived crop or redacted copy linked to the private original by hash; the derived copy never replaces the original evidence.
privacy_and_publication_boundary.raw_evidence_rule: Original scored evidence remains unedited in controlled storage and is not automatically a publication artifact.

r_static_view_qualification.accepted_fact: One near-overhead frame simultaneously shows the complete foam, all four 85-mm square boundaries and the paper support area.
r_static_view_qualification.foam_thickness_disposition: The 45-mm foam thickness creates a visible shadow but does not invalidate categorical boundary visibility.
r_static_view_qualification.remaining: Use this fixed direction for the original continuous R video and hash-bind it to the slot.

r_view_attempt_01.next_adjustment: Clamp the phone nearly overhead, keep the entire square and front support edge in frame, and record once without moving the phone or robot.
r_view_attempt_01.reason: The 22.218-s phone video is handheld and does not keep all four square boundaries visible in one fixed view.

review_projection_note: Historical pre-start status fields are retained as campaign metadata; final outcomes are recorded under results/final-revalidation/c115/.
technology_change_rule: An equivalent fixture, switch or other observer may replace this draft only before all 15 conditions are frozen and before C-01. After the first scored motion the observer technology and rules are immutable.

time_sync_attempt_01_disposition.effect: No detector retuning or repeat capture. Within-video categorical evidence and host controller evidence are evaluated separately.
